title: How Many People Is a Wage

files.name: ump.csv
files.unit: a province, as 21 years of minimum wage

machine.excluded_why: has no rural poverty line, having no countryside

robustness.household_size_is_external: This pipeline emits people, not a verdict. The average Indonesian household size is not in this file, so it is never multiplied in.
robustness.scale_economies: A per-capita line times N assumes a household of N shares nothing. It does, so this ratio understates how many a wage can hold.
robustness.upah_unit_assumed: `upah` is read as rupiah per hour. The file does not say so; upah x 173 sits within a quarter of the legal monthly floor in every province-year, which is the only evidence for it.
